about: Style study picks (contract §9). One candidate per motif and variant goes to public/art/_study/<variant>/ (review copies, never shipped). Variants: a = adv (1990s adventure: gouache + dark ink), b = comic (European comic album: bold brush ink, flat colours), c = film (1980s animated feature: painterly gouache, thin coloured lines). Background versions ending in L used the code-painted inns/village as a blurred layout init (denoise 0.85).
